Test: TC-2688 — Global - Task configuration - Changing dates of Jira tasks when Start date is mapped to Due date
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-117 Global - Task configuration
Labels: rocksolid, teamtree

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Gantt module of the box.
   Data: box: TC-2688 Global - Mapping Due Date to Start date field
   Expected: Task 1 is visible at the WBS and on the Gantt chart. 
The Current view is set to TC-2688 View.
At the WBS, there are columns:
Icon
Key
Summary
Due date (Jira)
End date (Jira)
Start Date (Built-in)
End Date (Built-in)
2. Using the inline editing at the WBS, set dueDate (Jira) of taskSummary.
   Data: dueDate: 18/Nov/21
taskSummary: Task 1
   Expected: After a while, Start Date (Built-in) is changed. Task 1 has also changed start date to 18/Nov/21 at the Gantt chart.
3. Using the inline editing at the WBS, set endDate (Jira) of taskSummary.
   Data: endDate: 25/Nov/21
taskSummary: Task 1
   Expected: After a while, End Date (Built-in) is changed. Task 1 has also changed end date to 25/Nov/21 at the Gantt chart.
4. Using the inline editing at the WBS, set dueDate (Jira) of taskSummary.
   Data: dueDate: 29/Nov/21
taskSummary: Task 1
   Expected: After a while, all dates are changed to 29/Nov/21. Task 1 has moved to 29/Nov/21 on the Gantt chart.
5. Using the inline editing at the WBS, set dueDate (Jira) of taskSummary.
   Data: dueDate: 18/Nov/21
taskSummary: Task 1
   Expected: After a while, Start Date (Built-in) is changed. Task 1 has also changed start date to 18/Nov/21 at the Gantt chart.
6. Using the inline editing at the WBS, set endDate (Jira) of taskSummary.
   Data: endDate: 16/Nov/21
taskSummary: Task 1
   Expected: After a while, all dates are changed to 16/Nov/21. Task 1 has moved to 16/Nov/21 on the Gantt chart.
7. Click on the key of the taskSummary to navigate to the Jira issues management.
   Data: taskSummary: Task 1
   Expected: Jira view of the Task 1 is visible in the new tab.
8. Set the new dueDate and endDate from the Jira level.
   Data: dueDate: 15/Nov/21
endDate: 23/Nov/21
   Expected: New dates are set correctly without any issues:
Due Date: 15/Nov/21
End Date: 23/Nov/21
9. Navigate back to the Gantt module of the box.
   Data: box: TC-2688 Global - Mapping Due Date to Start date field
   Expected: All dates at the WBS are set correctly:
Due Date: 15/Nov/21
End Date: 23/Nov/21
Start Date: 15/Nov/21
End Date: 23/Nov/21
Task 1 is correctly set on the Gantt chart.
10. Move taskSummary on the Gantt chart two days to the feature.
   Data: taskSummary: Task 1
   Expected: All dates at the WBS are changed correctly:
Due Date: 17/Nov/21
End Date: 25/Nov/21
Start Date: 17/Nov/21
End Date: 25/Nov/21
Task 1 is correctly set on the Gantt chart.
11. Move taskSummary on the Gantt chart one day to the past.

End Date: 24/Nov/21
Start Date: 16/Nov/21
End Date: 24/Nov/21
Task 1 is correctly set on the Gantt chart.
